hints.content: Taking the square root and squaring are inverse operations. So, the square root of any number squared is that same number.

As an easier example, let's evaluate $\left(\sqrt{\blue9}\right)^2$:

$\phantom{=} \left(\sqrt{\blue9}\right)^2$

$= \sqrt{\blue9} \cdot \sqrt{\blue9}$

$= 3 \cdot 3$

$= \blue9$.
